notes.title: Thank You for Your Love! Autumn Sales Begin + Exciting News Ahead!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, amazing Kittynawa fans![/b]

We can’t thank you enough for the overwhelming love and support you’ve shown for Pawsome Hidden Cats - Kittynawa! Watching you discover hidden cats, unravel Paw Village’s mysteries, and restore its magic has been an incredible journey.

[b]Autumn Sales Are Here![/b]

Today the Steam Autumn Sale kicks off, and Kittynawa will be available for 20% off! If you’ve been waiting to dive into the magical world of hidden cats, now’s the purr-fect time to grab your copy.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841060/Pawsome_Hidden_Cats__Kittynawa/

[b]Exciting News About What’s Next![/b]

While we can’t share too much just yet, we’re thrilled to hint that our next project is going to be something completely different from Kittynawa! Think dreamy, enchanting worlds with a touch of magic—and cats. It’s early days, but we promise it’ll be worth the wait!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884537/b4951724f5a36b2e9bd9c0de309154a33868a9a9.png[/img]

[b]More Hidden Object Games Coming![/b]

Pawsome Hidden Cats might be on a little pause as Horny Tales focuses on our exciting new game we can’t wait to share more about. But don’t worry, hidden object fans—the fun doesn’t stop there! The Purrfectly Hidden Cats series is getting a brand-new entry, with our partners at Bleeding Moon Studio hard at work on the 4th game in the series. Stay tuned for more playful challenges, hidden treasures, and, of course, plenty of adorable cats!

Thank you again for being part of our journey. Stay tuned for updates, and don’t forget to check out Kittynawa during the Autumn Sale!

Happy gaming,
The Gemcraft Games Team

notes.title: 🎉 #PawsomeHiddenCats - Kittynawa is Now Available! 🎉
notes.content:
The wait is over! We're excited to announce that Pawsome Hidden Cats - Kittynawa is now live on Steam! 🐾✨

Step into the enchanting world of Kittynawa, where you’ll embark on a heartwarming journey to uncover hidden secrets, meet mysterious feline characters, and restore peace to Paw Village. With captivating gameplay and beautiful hand-drawn art by Andrianna Alifragi, there’s so much to discover!

✨ What awaits you in Kittynawa:
🐱 A village full of hidden cats and mysteries
🎨 Stunning art that brings the world to life
🧩 Puzzles and challenges to keep you engaged
💖 A story of love, friendship, and restoration

We can’t wait for you to dive in and start your adventure! 
Thank you for supporting us and being part of this journey.
